title: Een vrije dag op de Enterprise
timing_source: Owner-requested listening passages; non-TNG boundaries from the recorded Whisper Large-v3 comparison, with context padding. Text alignment remains approximate.

passages.title: Wandeling en avontuur
passages.check: Check “Vanmorgen”, “Gewoon een/Gewone”, singular/plural, and whether “alleen” was spoken.

passages.title: Van / voor mij
passages.check: Both models suggest “voor”; confirm the preposition.

passages.title: Vrachtschip: possible stumble or omitted words
passages.check: Highest priority: write the exact spoken words, including a restart if present.

passages.title: Keiko haalt Molly op
passages.check: Is this simply the pronounced name Keiko + “haalde”, or did the wording change? Do not accept the models’ phonetic spelling as evidence of a slip.

passages.title: Moest / moet mezelf
passages.check: Both models suggest present tense “moet”; confirm.

passages.title: Werkzaamheden en drankpatronen
passages.check: Confirm “aan/dan” and whether there was a restart before “drankpatronen”.

passages.title: Woordvolgorde, Data en meetwaarde(n)
passages.check: Confirm word order, any restart after “daar”, and singular/plural meetwaarde(n). Preserve canonical spelling Data.

passages.title: Straling en metingen
passages.check: Models disagree: verify the actual phrase. Final -t is a spelling issue, not an audible extra word.

passages.title: Sensorplan afspreken/bespreken en tijdelijk
passages.check: Confirm “afspreken/bespreken”, “tijdelijk/duidelijk”, and any false start. Names retain Worf/Geordi spelling.

passages.title: Riker, ze aarzelen en eerste week/weken
passages.check: Confirm the sentence opening, whether “ze” is omitted, and week/weken.

passages.title: Laatste zin en eventuele herstart
passages.check: Check whether you restarted the closing sentence. V3 can repeat text on its own; do not assume all its repeats were spoken. The later pipeline replay also emits “(sneezes)”; check whether a non-speech sound is present.
